recipes.intro: Make warm oats in a hands-on kitchen simulation: wash, measure, chop, stir, use low heat, switch the stove off, and serve.
recipes.allergenNote: Contains milk when prepared with dairy milk. Read real package labels for allergies or cross-contact.
recipes.safety: Simulation only. An adult must supervise real knives and stovetops. Follow the oat package for cooking time and liquid amounts.

steps.title: Prepare clean hands
steps.instruction: At the sink, practice the correct handwashing order before touching food.
steps.safety: In a real kitchen, scrub with soap for at least 20 seconds. This activity shortens the time to a few clicks.

steps.title: Find your cooking tools
steps.instruction: Select every tool this recipe requires. Ignore the two distractors.
steps.safety: Use a stable board for cutting. Sharp knives require adult supervision.

steps.title: Measure rolled oats
steps.instruction: Each tap adds ½ cup of dry oats. Measure a total of 2 cups for the four-serving demonstration.
steps.safety: Measure on a level surface. The actual recipe is scaled in the main meal planner for your household.

steps.title: Clean the produce
steps.instruction: Wash the banana peel before handling and cutting, and keep your prep area clean.
steps.safety: Rinse fresh produce under running water; do not use soap on produce.

steps.title: Slice the bananas
steps.instruction: Tap each banana slice on the board to practice making five careful cuts.
steps.safety: Use the claw grip and a stable board. Ask an adult to handle the real knife.

steps.title: Measure milk
steps.instruction: Each tap pours ½ cup of milk. Aim for 2 cups in this demonstration.
steps.safety: Keep milk refrigerated before use. Check the actual product label for milk allergies.

steps.title: Combine the ingredients
steps.instruction: Place the measured oats and milk into the saucepan. Add water only as directed on the actual oat package.
steps.safety: Real quantities and cooking time vary by oat type. Follow package directions.

steps.title: Start the stovetop safely
steps.instruction: Set the simulated burner to LOW and place the pan on the burner.
steps.safety: An adult should supervise any real stovetop use. Turn pan handles inward and keep loose items away.

steps.title: Simmer and stir gently
steps.instruction: Stir five times. This simulation represents gradual heating; real oats require the package cooking time.
steps.safety: Keep hands clear of hot steam and never leave cooking unattended.

steps.title: Switch the stove off
steps.instruction: The food is ready in our simulation. Turn the burner OFF before leaving the stovetop.
steps.safety: Confirm the real burner is fully off. Allow the pan to cool before handling.

steps.title: Build the finished bowls
steps.instruction: Assemble the cooked oats, sliced banana, and cinnamon in that order.
steps.safety: Use a clean serving spoon, and check whether the food is too hot to eat.

steps.title: Serve and store safely
steps.instruction: Choose the best way to handle leftovers.
steps.question: What should happen to perishable leftovers?
options: Leave them at room temperature until tomorrow
Refrigerate promptly, generally within 2 hours
Keep them in the hot pan overnight
steps.safety: Refrigerate perishable leftovers promptly, generally within 2 hours. Use shallow containers to cool them faster.
